item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena is making a greeting card at home that lights up. She connects an LED to a cell using wires.
An LED only allows current to pass through it in one direction. It glows only when its longer terminal is connected to the positive side of the cell and its shorter terminal is connected to the negative side.
In which connection will the LED glow?

options.A: longer terminal to the negative side of the cell and shorter terminal to the positive side
options.B: longer terminal to the positive side of the cell and shorter terminal to the negative side
options.C: both terminals of the LED joined to the positive side of the cell
options.D: both terminals of the LED joined to the negative side of the cell
